name: coding
description: Default profile — the lean core-coding surface plus the loop tools it was missing. It ADDS `check`, `update_plan`, `tool_search`, and saved-output `recall` on top of files, shell (group:runtime), search, long-term memory (group:memory), and sub-agent spawn. Only `apply_patch` is dropped (edit_file/diff_edit cover it). The heavy web/research/media/messaging/pipeline tools and bundled skills stay excluded to keep per-round tool-schema overhead low; note the allow-list filter is applied to the visible registry, so those excluded tools are restored with `--profile coding-full`, not discovered at runtime. The M8.2 built-in sub-agents stay preloaded so `spawn` resolves them by id.
